Description.English: Under the influence of a strong northeast monsoon, the weather in Macao is expected to be fine and dry on Tuesday and Wednesday (10th and 11th Nov), with cool in the mornings and evenings. The minimum temperature will be around 16 degrees Celsius, and there will have significant diurnal temperature variations between day and night. The public is advised to take appropriate measures and be cautious of fire.( Update Time: 2026-11-10 00H10 )
